Priya (sales): Customer 'LedgerOne' filing request: want streaming tool calls + partial structured frames for progressive UI + reliable schema v1. Ticket #40122.
Liam (support): They currently get a single fn_call bubble at end; UX needs incremental events to render rows as results arrive. Also ask for per-frame IDs for audit.
Asha (product): Can they accept plain JSON frames first, then add schema enforcement later?
Priya (sales): Prefer schema from day one. Theyll pilot if we support schema versioning and an upgrade plan.
Marco (eng): Feasible approach: add event envelope mid-stream (type:tool_event / type:final). Need SDK helpers to stitch. Hard part: batching effects and function boundary semantics.
Asha (product): Propose scopes:
- Quick: opaque frames only, SDK returns raw frames (2w).
- Target: frames + server schema validation + SDK stitcher (8w).
- Full: above + HMAC signing, per-frame billing, Dedicated routing (12w).
Liam (support): Customer asks for Target.
Marco (eng): Estimate for Target: prototype 2w, full engineering ~6-8w with 2 backend devs and 1 SDK. Risk: ~5-12% gpu cost increase depending on frame frequency.
Asha (product): Acceptance criteria for pilot: event envelope spec, schema validation API, SDK stitcher, observability traces per-frame, latency regression <10% on pilot workload.
Priya (sales): I'll confirm pilot SLA (they want per-frame tail <200ms).
DeployBot: Meeting scheduled: product-pilot-check Fri 11:00 PT.
Asha (product): Action items: Priya confirm SLA and Dedicated, Liam attach ticket + transcripts, Marco draft RFC by EOW.
Liam (support): Ticket https://redwood.corp/tickets/40122 (internal).
